faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Q: What's the difference between single and membership?
faq.a1: A: Single is for occasional use; membership is for users who need long-term fortune tracking or frequent consultations. Membership offers unlimited access with exclusive services.
faq.q2: Q: Can I get a refund?
faq.a2: A: Single consultations are non-refundable once started; unused memberships can request a refund within 7 days.
faq.q3: Q: How accurate are the results?
faq.a3: A: Fortune-telling analysis provides probabilistic reference, not absolute prophecy. We aim to give you a valuable thinking framework in an uncertain world.
